# Themes

## Rules

- Prose that is not a table.

## Catalog

| Id | Name | Group | Looks | One line for the picker |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `system` | Default | Classic | follows system | Cool gray |
| `night` | Night | Classic | always dark | True black |
| `paperish` | Paperish | Grain | always light | Gray stock |
| `ghost` | Ghost | Color | follows system | Has no section |
